profit_quality.assessment: The operating business is cash generative: 2023-2025 operating cash flow exceeded parent net profit each year, and capex remained modest. The denominator still needs a haircut because reported profit includes investment and interest items, advertising demand can be cyclical, and cash is largely inside mainland/VIE structures.
adjustments: Use operating profit rather than reported parent net profit as the starting point because 2025 parent profit includes US$76.7m equity method income and US$21.3m investment fair value gain.
Apply an approximate normalized tax burden to operating profit and deduct maintenance capex proxy; pre-haircut distributable cash profit is set at US$370.0m.
Apply 0.80 profit haircut for advertising cyclicality, platform/regulatory/VIE structure and incomplete maintenance versus growth capex split.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2023-2025 OCF was US$672.8m, US$639.9m and US$519.5m; capex was US$36.8m, US$61.5m and US$42.4m.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Stable cash conversion supports a relatively high factor, but not 0.9-1.0 because the industry is ad-cycle exposed and headline profit contains non-operating investment/interest components.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: OCF / parent net profit over 2023-2025 is above 1.0; 2025 OCF / parent net profit is about 1.16.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: 2025 capex of US$42.368m is used as maintenance proxy because servers, computers and office equipment are the primary capex categories.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: No large multi-year working capital drain was identified; 2025 had other non-current asset increase and accrued liability decrease partly offsetting cash conversion.
